solutions.title: Hash set with snapshot sampling
solutions.strategy: Track membership in a set and convert it to an indexed snapshot when random access is requested.

timeComplexity.explanation: Set updates are average constant time, but getRandom builds an array view of all current members before sampling.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The set stores every active value, and getRandom may allocate a temporary snapshot.

solutions.title: Indexed array plus value positions
solutions.strategy: Store values in an array and map each value to its index, swapping the removed value with the last item before popping.

timeComplexity.explanation: insert, remove, and getRandom all use average constant-time hash map and array operations.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The array and index map each store every active value once.
